name: 25304 · Charleston, WV
findings: ZIP 25304 (Charleston) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25304 (Charleston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 25304 (Charleston) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
